subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw retroactively publish signed macOS assets and a beta appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1, or treat that historical beta as intentionally npm-only while pursuing future signed-beta gates separately?
rationale: The current repo state proves the assets/feed are still missing, but current docs allow beta macOS omission and actual publication depends on private release-owner credentials and policy.

options.title: Retire the old beta as npm-only
options.body: Confirm this historical beta will not receive desktop assets, then close this tracker and keep future enforcement in the paired PR or a narrower replacement.

options.title: Backfill this beta
options.body: Run the private macOS release-ops validation/publish path for v2026.5.22-beta.1 and commit a valid `appcast-beta.xml` for the signed ZIP.

options.title: Defer behind paired PR
options.body: Keep this issue open until the signed-beta distribution PR lands or is explicitly closed, then re-evaluate the tag-specific release action.

recommendation.title: Retire the old beta as npm-only
recommendation.body: Confirm this historical beta will not receive desktop assets, then close this tracker and keep future enforcement in the paired PR or a narrower replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is around appcast publication and release-process ownership, and the decision requires release-owner access to the macOS signing/appcast path.
